verdict.rationale: Aleph's llms.txt claims 'versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and board-ready variance analysis', and it advertises headcount planning, which could underpin a hiring-wave scenario. These are single-line marketing claims with no detail on how scenarios are built or compared. Missing for 10: documented side-by-side scenario comparison, a workflow for creating named scenarios (hiring wave, slipped quarter, downside case), in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create scenarios (a hiring wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case) and compare them side by side

citations.quote: Versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and board-ready variance analysis.
Headcount planning backed by live HRIS, ATS, ERP, and spreadsheet data.
